reviewed_by: Claude review of routing-step thinking in provider chat
reason: A tool-enabled chat turn calls the provider once per routing step and once more for the closing synthesis. ChatService._stream_tool_turn read each routing response's `reasoning` for usage accounting and then discarded it: no reasoning_delta was yielded and nothing reached the saved message, whose reasoning came from the synthesis response alone. With an OpenRouter reasoning model (deepseek, kimi: both advertise `reasoning` in supported_parameters, so Nebula does request it) essentially all of the thinking happens in those routing steps, so the Thinking disclosure stayed empty for the whole tool phase and empty altogether when the synthesis answered without thinking again. Chats with tools off stream through _stream_with_context_recovery, which always forwarded REASONING_DELTA, which is why thinking appeared for some turns and not others. ChatTurn now carries the episode: _add_usage folds each response's thinking into turn.reasoning on the write it already makes, the routing loop yields the added text as a reasoning_delta, the synthesis's first thought is separated from the routing thoughts by a blank line, and _completion saves turn.reasoning while the empty-response guard still judges the synthesis response alone. ModelProvider.stream's non-streaming fallback emitted TEXT_DELTA but never REASONING_DELTA, so its thinking only appeared in the completed event. An assistant turn that finishes with thinking and no answer text now says so in the transcript instead of rendering an empty bubble. test_chat_tool_loop asserts the streamed deltas concatenate to exactly the stored episode and that a wordless routing step adds no gap; test_providers covers the fallback's event order; interface.spec.ts gains a thinking-without-an-answer turn, and ui/playwright-impact.json routes chat and SessionsPage changes to area:provider-thinking, which had no rule reaching it. Rebased onto #413 and #415, which reworked chat workbench reliability and UI components in the same files; the selected suites were re-run on that base.
exclusions: No frontend unit tests: SessionsPage.tsx has no unit suite, and the one render conditional added there is asserted by the new interface.spec.ts turn; chatMessageReconciliation and HarnessThinking already pass unchanged and neither is touched. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No screenshot baselines: the new note is text in an existing message body and no baselined surface changes geometry. Playwright is area:provider-thinking only, on the three profiles that catalogue it (desktop, Android Chromium, iPhone WebKit): area:assistant is excluded because it carries the whole assistant-real-desktop real-Core project (48 tests) for a change whose streamed event sequence is pinned exactly by the Python tests, and area:core-api is excluded because the ChatTurn change is one optional field with a default that no API surface reads. tests/test_playwright_impact.py and tests/test_test_selection.py are included for the manifest edit. No full suites.
